summary: Lie on a flat bench, lower a barbell to your lower chest and press it back up over your shoulders. Chest, front shoulders and triceps.

thumbnail.brief: One image that says bench press: three-quarter view from the front and slightly above, mid-press, bar just off the chest, chest highlighted. No rack, no background.
thumbnail.review: Reads as bench press at a glance: three-quarter view, bar just off the chest, bench and bar fill the frame. Bench perspective is slightly stretched; fine at thumbnail size.

steps.title: Lie down under the bar
steps.do: Lie back on the bench and slide up until the racked bar is straight above your eyes. Plant both feet flat on the floor, under your knees.
remember: Eyes directly under the bar
Head, upper back and glutes all on the bench
Feet flat, heels down, knees over the ankles

visual.brief: Figure lying on the bench inside the rack, arms at the sides, eyes under the racked bar, feet flat under the knees.
visual.review: Arms at the sides, feet flat under the knees, same rack and bench as every other side frame. The bar sits a little behind the eyes rather than over them; close enough to teach the idea.

steps.title: Set your shoulders and back
steps.do: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and tuck them down toward your back pockets. Your chest lifts and a small gap opens under your lower back. Push the floor away with your feet.
remember: Shoulder blades back and down, pinned to the bench
A slight arch, not a bridge: glutes stay down
Legs tense, pushing the floor, hips still

visual.brief: Torso from shoulders to hips at bench-top height: upper back and glutes pressed down, a thin gap under the lower back.
visual.review: Camera at bench-top height does the job: upper back and glutes down, a clear gap under the lower back, no tint. Head is out of frame, which keeps the eye on the arch.

steps.title: Grip the bar
steps.do: Take the bar a little wider than your shoulders, wrap your thumbs around it and set it low in your palms so your wrists stay straight.
remember: A hand's width outside each shoulder
Thumbs wrapped, never a thumbless grip
Bar over the heel of the hand, wrists straight

visual.brief: Bird's-eye view of the figure under the racked bar, hands on the bar a little wider than the shoulders, thumbs around.
visual.review: Grip width, thumbs around the bar, bar in the hooks above the head, feet on the floor beside the bench. Clean.

steps.title: Unrack
steps.do: Press the bar up out of the hooks and bring it forward until it sits directly over your shoulders with your arms straight. Settle, breathe in, brace.
remember: Straight up first, then forward over the shoulders
Arms locked before you start the rep
Breathe in and brace before you lower

visual.brief: Arms straight, bar lifted just clear of the hooks and starting forward. The app draws the forward arrow.
visual.review: Arms straight, bar just clear of the hooks and still over them. Visually close to the re-rack frame; the arrow is what tells them apart.

steps.title: Lower to your chest
steps.do: Bend your elbows and lower the bar in two to three seconds. Keep your elbows about 45 degrees from your torso so your forearms stay vertical.
remember: Two to three seconds down, under control
Elbows about 45 degrees out, not flared, not pinned
Forearms vertical, wrists straight

visual.brief: Bar halfway between lockout and chest, elbows bending, forearms vertical. The app draws the downward arrow.
visual.review: Bar halfway, elbow near 90 degrees, forearm vertical. Used twice: the lowering arrow and the pressing arrow are drawn by the app.

steps.title: Touch your lower chest
steps.do: Let the bar touch the lower part of your chest, at the base of the sternum. Pause for a beat without bouncing.
remember: Lower chest, never the neck
Elbow directly under the bar
Touch, do not bounce; shoulder blades stay pinned

visual.brief: Bar resting on the lower chest, elbow under the bar, forearm vertical, feet still flat.
visual.review: Bar on the chest, forearm vertical. The plate hides the hand, and the contact is nearer mid-chest than the base of the sternum. Acceptable; a plate-free version would be clearer.

steps.title: Press up and slightly back
steps.do: Drive the bar up and a little back toward your face so it finishes over your shoulders. Push the floor with your feet and keep your hips on the bench.
remember: Up and slightly back, a shallow curve
Feet drive, hips stay down
Breathe out through the hardest part

visual.brief: Same mid-rep frame; the app draws the up-and-back arrow.
visual.review: Same mid-rep frame as step 5 with the up-and-back arrow.

steps.title: Lock out and repeat
steps.do: Finish with straight arms, bar over your shoulders. Breathe in, brace again, and start the next rep.
remember: Arms straight, bar over the shoulders
Reset your breath between reps
Shoulder blades still back and down

visual.brief: Arms locked, bar over the shoulders, clear of the hooks.
visual.review: Arms locked, bar over the shoulders, clear of the hooks. Clean.

steps.title: Re-rack
steps.do: After the last rep, with arms straight, push the bar back until it touches the uprights, then lower it into the hooks.
remember: Arms stay locked while you move back
Touch the uprights first, then lower
Never aim for the hooks directly

visual.brief: Arms straight, bar pushed back against the uprights just above the hooks. The app draws the back-then-down arrow.
visual.review: Bar against the uprights above the hooks, arms straight. Reads correctly with the back-then-down arrow.
